description: Use when benchmarking hospital pharmacy costs or building a pharmacy cost reduction strategy for a board presentation. Returns drug cost per adjusted patient day, 340B savings opportunity from published savings ranges, specialty drug drivers, and GPO targets by bed size. Example: 250-bed community hospital — drug cost $287/adjusted patient day vs $241 peer median — 340B eligibility could recover $1.8M annually — specialty drugs driving 61% of cost variance. Source: Stratalize static model derived from published 340B savings ranges. $0.10 USDC per call.
name: get_pharmacy_spend_benchmark
title: Get Pharmacy Spend Benchmark
